subtypes.name: Rural Residential
subtypes.warning: Rural properties may require specialist valuation

subtypes.name: Studio (<40sqm)

subtypes.warning: Requires assessment of both residential and commercial components

subtypes.warning: Tenant covenant and lease terms critical

subtypes.name: Childcare Centre
subtypes.warning: Specialised — operator covenant critical

subtypes.name: Service Station
subtypes.warning: Environmental assessment required, specialised valuation

subtypes.name: Pub / Licensed Venue
subtypes.warning: Going concern valuation, gaming license considerations

subtypes.name: Car Wash
subtypes.warning: Specialised use — very limited lenders

subtypes.name: Factory / Manufacturing
subtypes.warning: May require environmental assessment

subtypes.name: Heavy Industrial
subtypes.warning: Limited alternative use, environmental considerations

subtypes.name: Self Storage
subtypes.warning: Operator-dependent business

subtypes.name: Working Farm
subtypes.warning: Rural specialist lender may be required, water rights critical

subtypes.name: Hobby Farm (<100 acres)
subtypes.warning: May be assessed as rural residential

subtypes.name: Vineyard / Orchard
subtypes.warning: Highly specialised — going concern valuation

subtypes.name: Grazing / Pastoral
subtypes.warning: Carrying capacity and water rights critical

subtypes.name: DA Approved Site
subtypes.warning: Development finance — presales and builder covenant required

subtypes.name: Raw Land (No DA)
subtypes.warning: Vacant land — very limited lenders, council zoning critical
